Steps[]

  1. Head to the "Wishing Stall" and create even more festival vibe (Raise the Popularity to above 20,000)
  2. Tour around Taoyuan Vale

Gameplay Notes[]

  • This quest is time limited.
  • Rewards will be received after the "Tour around Taoyuan Vale" step.
  • When completing the "Tour around Taoyuan Vale" step, the quests Chasing the Moon, Here and Now and Moon Shall Be My Guest will be available on the map.
  • You can choose which route for Chasing the Moon's Glory to complete; you will be able to do the other later.
  • Completing the quest awards the player the Moments with You trophy Paint Me As Your Friend.

Dialogue[]

Quest Description
The Moonlit Fair has started as expected. Please maintain its popularity.
Rover: The Moonlit Fair isn't over yet. There might be something I can help with. I should check out the Wishing Stall.
(Reach 20,000 Popularity)
With the Moonlit Fair drawing to a close, you decide to take a stroll in Taoyuan Vale...
Quest Description
Not far away from Yumyum Haven, you meet Zhezhi, who is troubled by a lack of inspiration for her paintings. Ask her about it.
(Interact with the shiny spot on the ground)
Admire the moon with Zhezhi
(She's been standing there since the afternoon...)
Zhezhi: Hmm... "Capture the stalls and the Wishing Tree together, to show the festive atmosphere... ideally with the moon in the background." Ugh... should I find another spot to paint?
What are you doing here?
Zhezhi: With these requirements... the composition... isn't right either...
Zhezhi: Oh...! Sorry, are-are you talking to me?
Yes.
Actually, I was talking to the hand floating behind you.
Zhezhi: What!? Wh-wh-what's behind me?!
Hey, relax. I'm only kidding.
Zhezhi: Please, don't s-scare me like that...
Zhezhi: Sorry... I didn't notice you there just now...
I remember your name is...
Zhezhi: (So (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍) remembers me? But wait... did I tell (‍‍himText for male Rover‍/‍herText for female Rover‍‍) my name? We've only met once, so it's natural if (‍‍heText for male Rover‍/‍sheText for female Rover‍‍) can't remember me...)
Zhezhi: (Should I introduce myself one more time...? I should do something so it doesn't get awkward, right? Ugh, what to do...)
Zhezhi: I...
Zhezhi. That's your name, right?
Zhezhi: Y-yes! I'm Zhezhi. You got my name right.
Zhezhi: (Oh thank goodness, (‍‍heText for male Rover‍/‍sheText for female Rover‍‍) didn't forget me...)
Zhezhi: I-I remember you too! You said you go by the name Rover.
The festival's over. Aren't you going home?
Zhezhi: No, the Artists of Huanglong have requested a painting for the Moon-Chasing Festival, and I'm still searching for inspiration... It's been a bit of a struggle, but I'll head back once it's done.
It's getting pretty late.
Zhezhi: Well, it's not that... Wait, is that the time already?!
Everyone else has left.
Zhezhi: That's... that's okay. I prefer quiet places... Plus, I live right here in Jinzhou, not too far away...
Rover: (Leaving her alone here... doesn't sit right.)
Have you had dinner yet?
Zhezhi: Me? I'm not really that hungry—
Zhezhi: Uh...
Let me cook something for you.
You borrow the stove at Yumyum Haven to cook some food with the ingredients you have.
I borrowed Uncle Li's stove. Come on, give it a try.
Zhezhi: Really? Thank you... But I still haven't finished my painting—
Can't work on an empty stomach.
You can eat and look for inspiration at the same time.
Zhezhi: You're right... Don't mind if I do!
Zhezhi: It's sooo delicious! It's almost as good as Uncle Li's... No, it tastes even better with those extra seasonings.
Thank you.
Oh, by the way, how was your Moon-Chasing Festival?
Zhezhi: Oh, um... It was okay, I guess. Nothing much, really... Hehe.
...?
Zhezhi: (Oh, should I be honest? No, no, I can't worry (‍‍himText for male Rover‍/‍herText for female Rover‍‍). A little white lie won't hurt, right?)
Series([], ) Zhezhi: Actually...
Zhezhi: I didn't get to enjoy it much. I've been swamped with tasks lately, and I had to help Miss Xiao at her fan drawing stall.
Zhezhi: Sitting at the stall was exhausting. Just an hour there, and I think I'd need a day to recover.
Zhezhi: Anyway, I couldn't find anyone to go to the festival with me. I feel like I can't breathe in crowded places, but going alone also felt awkward...
Zhezhi: (Wait, did I just blurt out everything?! Is it normal to spill my guts to someone I barely know? Weird... I'm not even feeling jittery... am I always this awkward?! Oh dear...)
I see...
Zhezhi: (Does (‍‍heText for male Rover‍/‍sheText for female Rover‍‍) think I'm complaining? Am I coming across as too annoying?)
Zhezhi: I, uh, I'm not saying I didn't have a good time! Thanks to the festival, I've had lots of work, and I got paid for looking after the stall. I've made enough in just these few days to pay off three or four months of debt!
Zhezhi: (WHAT AM I SAYING! This just makes me sound miserable!)
Well, I guess we're enjoying the festival together now.
Even though it's just the two of us.
Zhezhi: (...The two of us? Does that mean we're on a... No, no, no, I'd better stop here. What am I thinking!?)
Zhezhi: It's good... just the two of us. Actually, it feels... right.
Rover: Most of the stalls are closed...
Rover: But we can still make wishes.
Zhezhi: This is...
Have you ever made a wish?
Zhezhi: Not yet, but...
Why not take this chance to make a wish?
Zhezhi: I...
Zhezhi: Before I make a wish, Rover, can I ask you a favor...?
Zhezhi: Can-can I put you in my painting? You'll only need to stand there for ten minutes... or maybe five... or three, I promise!
Why?
That's... a sudden request.
Zhezhi: I-I don't know! I just have this overwhelming urge... I want to include you in this painting. I feel like I need to... No, I want to!
Is this for the magazine?
Wouldn't it be a bit inappropriate to include me?
Zhezhi: No, I'm not talking about the painting I'm being paid to create...
Zhezhi: This painting, I want it to be... Just for myself.
(Quest Complete)
